result.reason: The clause reaches the fallback 90-day software/deliverable conformance warranty and includes the required remedies, legal compliance, malicious-code protection, and professional/workmanlike services standard. However, it does not specify the required 30-day fallback (or 90-day preferred) warranty period for services; the 90-day period applies only to the Interface and deliverables. Leaving the services warranty without a defined duration goes beyond or fails to precisely implement the playbook position. Unrelated Y2K terms and commercial intent are otherwise preserved.
